From Burning Down the House · Price: only objects that were destroyed or lost.

Theme Space

  • 1: 1 action: summon the ghost of a destroyed or lost object for 1 minute. It must be an object you know specifically: you saw it, or you have a reliable description of that exact object. The ghost has only the object's mundane form (no magic, runes or activations), and its item level can't be higher than your level. Only you, your stand and creatures you touch can use or interact with it. Surge: ghost walls close around a creature (@Check[reflex|against:stand]{Reflex} negates): it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{restrained} for 1 round.
  • 5: Ghost objects can be up to Large (a cart, a door, a bridge). The ghost walls hold a creature that critically fails its @Check[reflex|against:stand]{Reflex} save for 1 minute (it can Escape against your stand DC).
  • 9: 1 minute: open the ghost of a destroyed or lost room you know behind a crack in a wall. Only stand users can see the entrance. Up to 4 creatures can rest inside; it lasts until you leave or 8 hours pass.
  • 13: A ghost weapon uses the lost weapon's base stats and has the ghost touch property. Your stand can wield one: its first Strike with it each turn deals one extra weapon damage die. The ghost walls can close around up to two creatures at once.
  • 17: Ghost objects last 10 minutes.

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
